patient_context.name: Jordan Whitfield
patient_context.chart_background: 47-year-old established patient. Routine screening mammogram 9 days ago read as BI-RADS 0 (incomplete) — radiologist recommended additional imaging of the left breast. No prior breast biopsies. Family history: mother with post-menopausal breast cancer.

reasonCode.text: Abnormal screening mammogram (BI-RADS 0), additional imaging recommended

requester.display: Dr. Alicia Reyes, Bay Valley Primary Care

transcript.speaker: DR
transcript.text: Hi Jordan, good to see you. Thanks for coming back in so quickly.

transcript.speaker: PT
transcript.text: Of course. I got a call saying the mammogram needed another look? I've been a little anxious about it, honestly.

transcript.speaker: DR
transcript.text: That's completely understandable, and I want to be clear — this is a very common next step. The screening images just weren't complete enough to call one area on the left side, so the radiologist asked for additional pictures.

transcript.speaker: DR
transcript.text: So here's the plan — I'm ordering a diagnostic mammogram of the left breast, and I want you to have it done within the next two weeks. My office will help get it scheduled at an imaging center that takes your insurance.

transcript.speaker: PT
transcript.text: Two weeks — okay. Do I need to do anything to set it up?

transcript.speaker: DR
transcript.text: We'll handle the legwork — someone will reach out with a time and confirm it with you. All you'll need to do is show up. If anything comes back that needs follow-up, we'll talk through it together then.

transcript.speaker: DR
transcript.text: You're very welcome. Try not to read too much into the recall — let's just get the clearer pictures and go from there.

note: Assessment/Plan: 47F with BI-RADS 0 screening mammogram, radiologist recommends additional imaging of the left breast. Ordered diagnostic mammogram, left breast; to be completed within 2 weeks. Office to coordinate scheduling. Reassurance provided regarding recall.
after_visit_summary: We are ordering a follow-up (diagnostic) mammogram of your left breast to get clearer pictures. Please plan to have this done within the next two weeks. Our office will call you with an appointment time — you don't need to schedule it yourself.
